title: Do Complex Numbers Exist?
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder asks whether complex numbers are just a convenient tool or necessary in physics. She discusses a recent paper arguing that quantum mechanics cannot be done with real numbers alone.
why: HN recommends it as a short, accessible layperson explanation of the real-versus-complex quantum theory debate.

quote.text: I highly recommend video by Sabine Hossenfelder [1] on this topic.
